auth: Authorization: Bearer <token> required on all endpoints marked auth:true

errors.format: All non-SSE errors are JSON: {error: '<message>'} (HTTP status carries the semantic). Internal 500s always return {error: 'Internal server error'} with the real detail logged server-side

common.when: Request body is malformed JSON (body-parser parse failure)
No Authorization header or not a Bearer token (auth:true endpoints)
Bearer token does not match a live session (auth:true endpoints)
Unexpected server/DB/worker failure (details never exposed to the client)

endpoints.does: Create user + session; seeds example conversation + 'Getting started guide' document (linked to that conversation) with precomputed embeddings. Response returns immediately; seeding finishes shortly after

errors.when: Session exists but the user row was deleted

body.title: string 1-255
body.conversation_id: uuid (the conversation this document belongs to; must be owned by the user)

endpoints.does: Ingest pre-chunked content for one conversation: embeds all chunks in batches via worker (or OpenAI fallback), stores in pgvector. Search for that conversation will only retrieve these chunks

errors.when: conversation_id does not exist or belongs to another user

endpoints.query: limit (1-200, optional, default 50), offset (>=0, optional), conversation_id (uuid, optional filter)
endpoints.does: List user's documents (newest first); filter to one conversation with ?conversation_id=
Get one document with its chunks (scoped to user; stored 768-dim embedding vectors omitted unless include_embeddings=true)

errors.when: Document does not exist or belongs to another user

endpoints.does: Delete document + chunks via cascade (scoped to user)

errors.when: Document does not exist or belongs to another user

endpoints.query: from & to (optional ints, 1-based inclusive range, must come together, to >= from). Without them, returns the latest 100 messages
endpoints.does: Get conversation with messages (range = e.g. ?from=1&to=10 for first 10; default: latest 100)

errors.when: Invalid query params (e.g. from without to, or to < from)
Conversation does not exist or belongs to another user

endpoints.does: Examine the conversation's knowledge base: every chunk of every document attached to this conversation (document_title, heading, content, chunk_index). Embedding vectors omitted

errors.when: Conversation does not exist or belongs to another user
Conversation does not exist or belongs to another user

endpoints.does: Delete conversation + messages (scoped to user). Documents attached to this conversation and their chunks are deleted via cascade

errors.when: Conversation does not exist or belongs to another user

endpoints.does: RAG answer streamed: embed question -> top-K vector search scoped to THIS conversation's documents -> prompt -> LLM stream (worker or fallback). Client aborting the connection stops streaming and aborts the worker

errors.when: Conversation does not exist or belongs to another user (before the stream starts)
Worker/LLM/embedding failure mid-stream (real detail only logged server-side)
